Package org.clafer.frontend

package org.clafer.frontend
  • Class
    Description
    ClaferCommand
    claferc: the Clafer compiler's clafer -m clafer and clafer -m alloy in Java.
    ClaferExecutable
    The Clafer compiler, the Haskell clafer, that the Java tools run for what they do not do themselves (clafersg for a model with a [choco| |] escape or with --haskell-frontend, claferc for the modes it forwards): -Dclafer.executable, if it is set; otherwise clafer next to the jar of this class, as in Clafer Tools, where both bundles unpack into one folder with clafersg.jar, claferc.jar and clafer, so that the folder need not be on the PATH; otherwise clafer on the PATH.
    ClaferLexer
    Splits a model in the full Clafer language into tokens, as the compiler's lexer does (clafer.cf, generated by BNFC and Alex).
    ClaferLexer.Result
    The tokens of a model.
    ClaferParser
    Parses a model in the full Clafer language into its Syntax tree, as the compiler parses it (clafer.cf, generated by BNFC and Happy, and Language.Clafer.parse).
    ClaferParser.Result
    The tree of a model and its errors.
    Core
    The core of the explicit IR: a model is core if and only if it has no rich node (Ir.Node.isRich()).
    Diagnostic
    An error in the source, with where it is.
    ExplicitParser
    Reads the rich or the core explicit language, as the Clafer compiler prints them (clafer -m clafer, and --core), and the explicit form that chocosolver's AstPrinter prints, into the explicit IR.
    ExplicitParser.Result
    A parsed model.
    ExplicitPrinter
    Prints the explicit IR exactly as the Clafer compiler prints the rich and the core explicit model (Generator/Explicit.hs), with or without the provenance comments, so that every comparison of two models is a comparison of text.
    Ir
    The explicit IR: one tree for the rich and the core explicit language of Clafer, as the Clafer compiler prints them (clafer -m clafer, with --core for the core).
    Ir.AbstractMultiplicity
    The written bound of a top-level abstract clafer, which counts all its instances, rich: abstract Tools 3..6.
    Ir.Anchor
    An anchor, rich: initially p, at the birth of the context, or finally p, at its death.
    Ir.Assertion
    An assertion, assert [ exp ].
    Ir.Binary
    A chain of one binary operator: a op b op c.
    Ir.BinaryOp
    The binary operators, by their syntax.
    Ir.Call
    A function of strings, concat(a, b), prefix(a, b) or suffix(a, b).
    Ir.Card
    A cardinality, low..high, or low..*.
    Ir.Cast
    upcast(e, T) or downcast(e, T), as chocosolver's printer writes the casts of its analysis.
    Ir.ClaferDecl
    A clafer: [abstract] [modifiers] gcard name [: super] [-> | ->> target] card [initializer] { elements }.
    Ir.Connected
    connected(nodes, relation, directed).
    Ir.ConstantSet
    {[1, 2], [3, 4]} :: T * U, a constant set of chocosolver's printer: one row per column of the type.
    Ir.Constraint
    A constraint, [ exp ].
    Ir.DecimalLit
    A decimal as written, e.g., 19.99 or -0.5.
    Ir.Decl
    The declarations of a quantifier, [disj] x; y : set.
    Ir.DoubleLit
    A double as written, with its exponent, e.g., 1.2e2.
    Ir.Dref
    left.dref.
    Ir.Element
    A declaration or constraint of a model or of a clafer.
    Ir.EnumDecl
    An enumeration, rich: enum E = a | b, at the top level.
    Ir.Exp
    An expression.
    Ir.IfThenElse
    if c then a else b, a formula or a set.
    Ir.Initializer
    An initializer, rich: = value, or := each value or := together value, with its clock written out (kbak/clafer-semantics#194).
    Ir.InitKind
    The initializers, by their syntax.
    Ir.IntLit
    An integer, -3 with its sign.
    Ir.Join
    A navigation, left.right: the right is a name (a child relation), or in chocosolver's printing a relation or a parenthesized set.
    Ir.Model
    A model: its declarations and constraints in the order they were written, then its objectives and assertions, which the compiler prints at the end.
    Ir.Modifier
    A temporal modifier of a clafer, rich.
    Ir.ModifierKind
    The temporal modifiers, by their keywords.
    Ir.Name
    A name as written: of a clafer, a variable, or a type.
    Ir.NameExp
    A name in an expression: a clafer, all its instances or, on the right of a navigation, its relation, or a variable.
    Ir.NoClafer
    noclafer, the empty set.
    Ir.Node
    A node of the tree.
    Ir.Objective
    An objective, << max exp >> or << min exp >>.
    Ir.Options
    The options of the first line, //# OPTIONS --explicit, as the compiler writes them.
    Ir.Origin
    Where a clafer or constraint of the core comes from, as --record-provenance writes it: the rich construct that a lowering made it from, and the position of that construct, e.g., // final, model.cfr:56:5.
    Ir.ParentOf
    left.parent.
    Ir.Pattern
    A behavioral pattern of Dwyer et al.'
    Ir.PatternKind
    The patterns.
    Ir.PatternScope
    The scopes of a pattern.
    Ir.Position
    A position in a source file, as in the compiler's messages.
    Ir.Quantified
    q decls | body.
    Ir.QuantifiedSet
    A quantifier over a set, without variables: some x, no x, lone x, one x, all x.
    Ir.Quantifier
    The quantifiers.
    Ir.RefDecl
    A reference: -> target, a set, or ->> target, a bag.
    Ir.RelationOf
    dref(c) or parent(c), a relation of a clafer, as chocosolver's printer writes it.
    Ir.RootBlock
    Constraints directly under the root, root { [ exp ] }, as chocosolver's AstPrinter prints a model of its Java API that has them; Clafer has none.
    Ir.StringLit
    A string literal as written, with its quotes and escapes.
    Ir.Temporal
    A temporal operator of the core: X, F, G, previous, once, historically on one formula, U, W, since, triggered between two.
    Ir.TemporalOp
    The temporal operators of the core.
    Ir.This
    this.
    Ir.Transition
    A transition, rich: a --> b, a -[g]-> b, a -->> b or a -[g]->> b, whose target may be a chain of transitions.
    Ir.Unary
    A prefix operator.
    Ir.UnaryOp
    The prefix operators.
    Layout
    Turns indentation into blocks, as the compiler's layout resolver does (LayoutResolver.resolveLayout): a line indented more than the line before opens a block (TokenKind.INDENT), a line indented less closes the blocks it leaves (TokenKind.DEDENT), and a line at the indentation of a sibling is separated from the line before (TokenKind.SEPARATOR).
    Layout.Result
    The tokens with the layout made explicit.
    Lexer
    Splits the explicit form of a Clafer model, as AstPrinter prints it, into tokens.
    Lexer.Result
    The tokens of a source text.
    ModelFiles
    The files of a model: the model and the files it imports, transitively, with --import=FILE in their //# OPTIONS lines, as the compiler reads them (Import.readModel): local files and http or https URLs (Http).
    ModelFiles.ImportOptions
    The restrictions of the imports, which only the command line gives, as the web tools give them to the compiler:
    ModelFiles.ModelFile
     
    ModelFiles.Position
    A line in a file.
    ModelOptions
    The options of a model file that the frontend uses, from its first line, //# OPTIONS ..., as the compiler reads them (Import.fileOptions): --core, --tl, --minint, --maxint, --decimal-digits, --ss and --import.
    Names
    What the names of a model refer to, for the language server: the clafers, whose Symbols.ClaferSymbol.nameSpan() is where each is declared, and the clafer that each written name refers to, by the span of the name.
    Scopes
    The scopes that chocosolver solves an explicit model with, as the compiler writes them to the explicit model's scope file (clafer -m clafer --meta-data, model.des.cfr-scope).
    SourceSpan
    Where a clafer, constraint, assertion or objective is in the source model: from line:column up to, not including, endLine:endColumn.
    Symbols
    The symbols of a model, the first pass after the parser: a symbol per clafer, with its UID, its parent, its super clafer, the type of its reference, its card and group card with the defaults applied, its temporal modifiers and the clock of its initializer.
    Symbols.ClaferSymbol
    A clafer, or an enumeration or one of its literals.
    Symbols.GroupCard
    A group card.
    Symbols.Interval
    An interval of a card or a group card.
    Symbols.Reference
    The reference of a clafer.
    Symbols.RefModifier
    The modifiers of a reference: finalref, finaltarget, and final, which is both.
    Symbols.Result
    The symbols of a model.
    Syntax
    The syntax tree of a model in the full Clafer language, as written: the tree of the compiler's clafer.cf (AbsClafer), with a span for each node.
    Syntax.Anchor
    initially e or finally e.
    Syntax.Assertion
    An assertion, assert [ e ].
    Syntax.Binary
    A binary expression.
    Syntax.BinaryOp
    The binary operators, with their symbols and levels.
    Syntax.Card
    A cardinality: ?, +, *, a number or an interval.
    Syntax.CardNum
    A cardinality written as a number, 2.
    Syntax.CardSymbol
    A cardinality written as ?, + or *.
    Syntax.Clafer
    A clafer, e.g., abstract xor A : B -> int ? = 3 { ... }.
    Syntax.ClaferId
    A name in an expression.
    Syntax.ClaferTransition
    The transition of a clafer, --> e.
    Syntax.ClaferUse
    A use of a clafer, `A ? { ... }.
    Syntax.Constraint
    A constraint, [ e1 e2 ]: the conjunction of its expressions.
    Syntax.Decl
    The declaration of a quantifier, x; y : e.
    Syntax.Declaration
    A declaration at the top level.
    Syntax.Element
    An element: a clafer, a use of a clafer, a constraint, an objective or an assertion.
    Syntax.Elements
    The elements of a clafer, in braces or indented.
    Syntax.EnumDecl
    An enumeration, enum E = a | b.
    Syntax.Exp
    An expression.
    Syntax.GCard
    A group cardinality: a keyword or an interval.
    Syntax.Goal
    An objective, << minimize e >>.
    Syntax.GoalKind
    How an objective is written.
    Syntax.GroupKeyword
    A group cardinality written as a keyword: xor, or, mux or opt.
    Syntax.Ident
    A name as written, e.g., a clafer's name or a local variable.
    Syntax.IfThenElse
    if c then t else e.
    Syntax.Init
    An initializer, = e or := e.
    Syntax.InitHow
    How an initializer is written.
    Syntax.Let
    let x = v in body.
    Syntax.Literal
    A literal: an integer, a double, a real or a string, as written.
    Syntax.LiteralKind
    The kinds of literals.
    Syntax.Model
    A model: its declarations in the order they were written.
    Syntax.Name
    A path of names, a\b.
    Syntax.NCard
    An interval, 2..3 or 2..*, of a cardinality or of a group cardinality.
    Syntax.Node
    A node of the tree.
    Syntax.Pattern
    A behavioral pattern, e.g., never e after s, or a must precede b.
    Syntax.PatternKind
    The behavioral patterns.
    Syntax.PatternScope
    The scope of a pattern: before e, after e, between e and e, after e until e.
    Syntax.Quant
    The quantifiers.
    Syntax.QuantExp
    A quantified expression without a declaration, some e.
    Syntax.Quantified
    A quantified expression with a declaration, some disj x : e | body.
    Syntax.Reference
    A reference, -> e to a set or ->> e to a bag.
    Syntax.ScopeKind
    The scopes of a pattern.
    Syntax.Super
    The super clafer, : e.
    Syntax.TempModifier
    A temporal modifier of a clafer.
    Syntax.TempModifierKind
    The temporal modifiers.
    Syntax.TransArrow
    A transition arrow: -->, -->> (synchronous), or with a guard, -[ g ]-> and -[ g ]->>.
    Syntax.TransitionExp
    A transition, e1 --> e2.
    Syntax.Unary
    A prefix expression.
    Syntax.UnaryOp
    The prefix operators, with their symbols, levels and the levels of their operands.
    SyntaxPrinter
    Prints a syntax tree as the compiler's printTree prints its parse tree (PrintClafer, generated by BNFC): the same words, parentheses and line breaks.
    ToCore
    The lowering of the rich explicit model to the explicit core model: the port of the Clafer compiler's lowerAbstractBounds TopLevelBounds . lowerToCore (Intermediate/Core.hs, Initializers.hs, Finality.hs, AbstractMultiplicity.hs), pass by pass and in the same order, so that ExplicitPrinter.print(toCore(m)) is the compiler's --core output for the model of m.
    ToIr
    The explicit IR of a model in the full syntax, as the compiler gives it (clafer -m clafer), and its scopes.
    ToIr.Result
     
    Token
    A token: its kind, its text exactly as written, and where it is.
    TokenKind
    The kinds of tokens.
